verdict.rationale: Riveter's docs say users can build an enrichment from a natural-language prompt (the SDK takes a free-text `Prompt`) and ask a `search_agent` a plain question to get an AI-researched answer. It can also be driven from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP-compatible assistant through a hosted or local MCP server, so users can operate it conversationally. Missing for 10: no hands-on or independent corroboration that natural-language control works well, and no evidence that the full product surface (scheduling, monitoring, dataset management) can be run by natural language rather than structured parameters.
